course_summary:
ISEN 620 | Survey of Optimization | Fall 2025
Instructor: Sergiy Butenko | butenko@tamu.edu
Meets: Asynchronous | ONLINE
Grading: Exams [80%], Homework Quizzes [15%], Lecture Quizzes [5%] — A: [90,100], B: [80,90), C: [70,80), D: [60,70), F: [0,60)
Topics: Karush-Kuhn-Tucker Conditions, Conjugate Direction Methods, Newton's Method, Steepest Descent Method, Line Search, Root Finding, Second Order Optimality Conditions, FONC for Equality Constraints, FONC for Unconstrained Problems, Simplex Method in Matrix Form, Complementary Slackness, LP Duality, Sensitivity Analysis, Graphical Method, Simplex Method: Termination, Simplex Method: Initialization, Analysis of the Simplex Method, Simplex Method, IP Modeling, LP Modeling, LP Assumptions, Introduction to Optimization Software, deterministic linear optimization, deterministic nonlinear optimization, linear programming, unconstrained nonlinear optimization, constrained nonlinear optimization, classical optimality conditions, numerical algorithms, linear programming theory, nonlinear programming theory, linear programming algorithms, nonlinear programming algorithms, linear optimization models formulation, nonlinear optimization models formulation, real-world problems, small-scale optimization problems, large-scale problems, theory, numerical methods, optimization
Tools: AMPL, Excel, Solver add-on, Canvas, Zoom, GroupMe, YouTube, Google Drive
Prerequisites: MATH 304 or MATH 311
